profile.headline: Web Developer
profile.summary:
I’m a Front-End Web Developer with over 6 years of experience building responsive, user-focused websites and web applications. My background includes working with marketing agencies and freelance clients, developing projects using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Vue.js, and PHP. I’ve built custom solutions in WordPress, HubSpot, Webflow, Magento, and CRAFT CMS, and have used Vuetify for building sleek UIs.

I’m highly efficient in remote, collaborative environments, using tools like Git, Figma, Trello, Slack, and Asana. I also leverage modern AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude.ai to optimize my development process, generate documentation, explore solutions faster, and stay continuously up to date.

Currently, I’m expanding my front-end expertise by learning React.js and modern JavaScript frameworks to align with industry trends.
